The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8123` (see `ClickHouseBuilder.HttpPort`)
- Port: `9000` (see `ClickHouseBuilder.NativePort`)
- Environment variable: `CLICKHOUSE_DB=default` (see `ClickHouseBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `CLICKHOUSE_USER=clickhouse` (see `ClickHouseBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD=clickhouse` (see `ClickHouseBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /` to port `8123` is completed successfully.
